HeroSplit.purpose: Above-the-fold split hero with editable heading, copy, buttons, and image.
HeroSplit.layout: full section -> boxed row -> text column + media column
HeroSplit.responsive: tablet and mobile stack columns to 100%

HeaderNavMenu.purpose: Responsive site header using a real WordPress nav menu and Elementor Pro nav-menu widget.
HeaderNavMenu.layout: full header section -> boxed nowrap row -> brand column + nav menu column
HeaderNavMenu.responsive: nav-menu collapses at the configured Elementor breakpoint and uses native mobile toggle controls

DesignFoundation.purpose: Design-system foundation section for typography, colors, and button styles before site pages are built.
DesignFoundation.layout: full section -> boxed column -> heading group -> typography/actions column + color swatch grid
DesignFoundation.responsive: split on desktop, stacked on tablet and mobile

GalleryGrid.purpose: Reusable native image gallery for portfolios, albums, and visual proof sections.
GalleryGrid.layout: full section -> boxed column -> heading group -> image grid

FeatureGrid.purpose: Editable card grid for services, benefits, or features.
FeatureGrid.layout: full section -> boxed column -> heading group -> wrapping row of cards

ContentSplit.purpose: Story or about section with text and image.
ContentSplit.layout: full section -> boxed row -> media + content

StatsBand.purpose: Proof band with native counter widgets.

FaqList.purpose: Editable FAQ list using native toggle widget when supported, otherwise structured heading/text cards.

ContactPanel.purpose: Contact information and Elementor Pro form split layout.
ContactPanel.layout: full section -> boxed row -> contact column + form column
